rows.printed_name: Б. ЕЛЬЦИН (signature; point 1 names the office, not a person)
rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: Citing Article 121-1 and Article 121-5(6) of the RSFSR Constitution and point 2 of the Congress resolution of 1 November 1991, the decree states that for the period of the economic reform the Government of the RSFSR is headed by the President of the RSFSR ('На период экономической реформы Правительство РСФСР возглавляет Президент РСФСР'). It is signed 'Президент РСФСР Б. ЕЛЬЦИН, Москва, Кремль, 6 ноября 1991 года, N 171'.

rows.role_title: Председатель Правительства — Chairman of the Government
rows.text: The decree instructs the Council of Ministers of the RSFSR to carry out its duties until the new composition of the Government of the RSFSR is formed, and asks the Vice-President and the State Secretary to submit reorganisation proposals within three days.
